# Onnelan mökit

> Two year-round log villas for rent on the shore of Lake Puula at Läsäkoski, Kangasniemi, South Savo (Etelä-Savo), Finland. Book directly by phone or email, or on Airbnb.

- Address: Nurmelantie 209, 51430 Läsäkoski, Kangasniemi, Finland
- Phone: +358 15 437 189, +358 44 0939 365
- Email: varaukset@onnelanmokit.com
- Business ID: 1940821-7

## Villas

- [Villa Onnela](https://www.onnelanmokit.com/en/villa-onnela): log villa completed in 2015, about 145 m², 3 bedrooms, sleeps 6 + 2, everything on one level. Separate wood-heated shore sauna, electric sauna, fireplace, geothermal heating, sandy gently deepening beach that suits children, rowing boat, sleeping cabin, barbecue shelter, carport. Allergy-free, no pets.
- [Villa Suvikallio](https://www.onnelanmokit.com/en/villa-suvikallio): five-star MALO-rated log villa built in 2000 at the tip of a narrow cape, about 90 m², 2 bedrooms on two floors, sleeps 4 + 2, lake view from every window. Separate wood-heated shore sauna, electric sauna, hot tub (extra charge), large grill hut, beach volleyball court, rowing boat, carport.
